remarks: Bright and inviting, this spacious unit features an open layout with gleaming hardwood floors throughout. The expansive living room and dedicated dining area provide the perfect setting for both relaxation and entertaining. The well-appointed kitchen includes granite countertops, abundant cabinetry, and a pantry. A private screened-in balcony offers the perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or take in some fresh air. The generously sized bedroom easily accommodates a king-sized bed and provides ample closet space for all your storage needs, while the full bath adds comfort and convenience. Enjoy everyday ease with top-notch building amenities, including full-time front desk staff, community lounge, and a fully-equipped fitness center. Heat, hot water, and central air are included, along with one assigned garage parking spot for added convenience. Ideally situated you're just minutes away from public transportation, top rated dining, shopping and entertainment. Don't miss this opportunity!
